svg.aria-label: Animated comparison: SGD and schedule-free SGD both converge in a gradient field; in a rotational field SGD converges and schedule-free SGD diverges.
svg.title: Schedule-free is stable in gradient fields and unstable in rotational ones

g.text: grey arrows: the flow −F(w) each optimizer follows

svg.text: minimisation: the regime schedule-free was built for
a regularised two-player game near its equilibrium
SGD spirals in; schedule-free spirals out.
SGD |w| = 0.005 after 150 steps; schedule-free leaves the frame at step 82 (|w| = 9.1 at 150)
F(w) = (λI + ωJ)w with λ = 1 (the regulariser's pull) and ω the game's rotation. Same start, same step γ = 0.05, 150 steps; real torch SGD and
schedulefree.SGDScheduleFree. Schedule-free evaluates the gradient at y = (1−β)z + βx, pulled toward its running average x, which lags behind a rotating iterate.
